svg.title: Two-bay eight-storey frame — dimensioned structural elevation
svg.desc: Exact undeformed member centrelines at the specified coordinate map. All forty member lengths are dimensioned in mm. Three clamped bases and all listed nodal loads are shown. Numerical structural response is unavailable; neither limit has been assessed.

g.text: Structural elevation · undeformed centrelines · dimensions in mm
Red arrows: applied nodal forces; magnitudes in the load schedule.
+x → right; +y ↑ up. Member and node IDs are retained.
Solid rectangles; b × h in mm. E = 200000 N/mm².
h in frame plane; b out of plane. A = bh; I = bh³/12.
i = 0, 1, 2; j = 0, 1. Storeys numbered bottom to top.
Signed forces in N; applied Mz = 0 N mm.
Arrows show direction only, not force scale.
Peak stress limit: 180.0 MPa — NOT ASSESSED
Displacements and member-end forces have not been evaluated; no solver run is claimed.
No pass/fail conclusion or overall safety claim is made.
Linear elasticity; small displacements; rigid joints; axial and Euler–Bernoulli bending only. Loads act at listed nodes only.
Excluded: shear deformation, self-weight, buckling, out-of-plane behaviour and connection flexibility.
This drawing concerns only the stated 2D frame, not complete product or building validation.
